title: •Lieutenant Grond
caption: •Lieutenant Grond (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. Adds one battle destiny with Colonel Dyer or if driving a swoop. May place Lieutenant Grond in Used Pile to cancel a Force drain at a related location.
lore: Colonel Dyer’s aide. Coordinates *scout* actions. As a youth, raced swoops on homeworld of Corellia. Formerly served with Emperor’s Demonstration Team.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1999 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2, third box printed blank; deploy 2 / forfeit 3. Yellow (DS) pilot-power icon followed by '2.' → {pilot:2} (stub: 'Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots'). Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow DS helmet), warrior (blue, blaster). Imperial (Imperial disc top-left, grey Imperial frame on the base scan). Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophes in Dyer’s and Emperor’s (wiki straight); 'scout' is printed visibly heavier/wider than its neighbours on the 350 px scan → *scout* bold (low-res; consistent with Decipher's characteristic bolding). Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright line not legible on the 350 px scan; set-convention form. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
